thread:
maria: Heads-up — I see a sustained error spike on the Console /generate route since the canary rolled at ~08:30. Dash shows 5xxs up 6x vs baseline. Can someone from runtime/sre confirm tracing hooks are firing for the canary pods? :eyes:

jun: On it. Which cluster/commit? I can start with traces and logs.

maria: cluster: us-west-2-console, canary tag: canary-2026-03-10. Error pattern looks like 'kv-cache timeout' followed by 502s.

samir: I pulled spans for a few failed requests — traces exist, but many spans lack the custom console.error tags we add in trace-hook. Looks like the hook isn't attaching on serverless workers.

tara: That matches an alert I saw earlier — serverless lambdas upgraded runtime, maybe hook bootstrap path changed. I tagged @eng-sre in the alert.

eli: deploy-bot: Canary deployment canary-2026-03-10 -> success (3/3 healthy). Just reported.

maria: Thanks. Two asks: (1) who owns fixing the hook bootstrap for serverless so error tags show up (we need them for the error-analysis view), (2) we need a short-term retention decision: keep these traces 90d for investigation or tier down to 30d to save costs.

samir: I can own the hook fix in runtime. Quick question: are we using the lightweight hook (inline init) or dynoadv plugin? If dynoadv, the lambda layer path changed in the latest runtime.

tara: Ops: this is a cross-team dep. If runtime wants to change the layer path, eng-sre needs to update the warmup policy and patch the canary baseline.

jun: For retention, we currently default to 30d on most prod traces. For Console-high-priority errors I'd vote 90d for at least one week while we triage. Maybe 90d for traces tagged console:checkpoint=true.

maria: Agreed. Proposal: samir patches hook (ETA today EOD), eng-sre validates canary behavior (tara / @eng-sre), we flip a temporary retention rule for traces with tag console:incident=2422223333 -> 90d for 7 days, then revert to 30d. Whoever owns retention config?

tara: I can update the retention policy in the telemetry service and add a short-lived rule, but I need the exact tag key/value. Also need eng-privacy signoff for >30d? Not for 90d transient but will cc.

samir: Working on a patch now. Local repro shows missing attach in lambda cold start. Patch will change bootstrap check from /opt/hooks/init -> /var/runtime/hooks/init. Small change, tests pass locally.

maria: Nice. Can you drop the PR link here when ready and set reviewers to jun and tara? Also include a line in the PR about the retention flip needing telemetry change.

samir: PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/runtime/trace-hooks/pulls/812. Title: fix(lambda): attach trace hook path for new runtime. PTAL @jun @tara.

jun: Reviewing now. Quick note: for the error-analysis dashboard to pick up, we also need the span attribute name to be console.error_code (not console.err). samir, can you map both for a week to avoid gaps?

samir: Yep — will emit both attributes in the patch for a 7-day overlap window.

tara: I'll schedule the retention change for 09:00 UTC and ping eng-privacy. Will also run a quick canary through the patched runtime and report back.

maria: Thanks team. Action items: samir -> patch + emit both attrs (ETA EOD), jun -> review PR, tara/eng-sre -> validate canary + apply retention rule at 09:00 UTC, maria -> coordinate post-mortem and update error-analysis view owners.

eli: deploy-bot: Canary redeploy scheduled by tara at 09:00 UTC.

jun: PR merged (812) — small tweak, added tests. samir please follow up if you notice any trace attr drops.

samir: Patch deployed to canary. Initial checks show console.error_code present. Still seeing a small tail of 502s but spans now have tags.

tara: Retention rule applied: telemetry.rule_id=rl-2422-console-90d, set to 90 days for traces with console:incident=2422223333. eng-privacy looped.

maria: I'll take the post-mortem writeup tomorrow morning, include timeline + decision on 90d -> 30d revert plan. If anyone sees new regressions drop a note here. :thumbsup:

jun: FYI, added a dashboard tile to mark traces with console:incident=2422223333 so SRE can filter quickly.

maria: Closing loop — excellent cross-team work. Will update owners in the error-analysis view metadata. :tada:
